info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Creditcard Applications Documents-v2-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Applications Document Retrieval API facilitates the access and listing of documents related to credit card applications. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can efficiently retrieve supporting documents for numerous applications in a streamlined manner. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions, credit card issuers, and compliance teams who need quick access to application-related documentation for review and processing. Developers can leverage this API to enhance workflow automation and ensure compliance with documentation requirements.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of documents for applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all documents associated with applications. It provides an overview of all relevant documentation, including status and type, enabling efficient management and review of application submissions.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving a list of documents associated with applications. This body should provide the necessary parameters to filter and paginate the results effectively.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested documents.

ListCreditcardApplicationsDocumentsReque.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on documents in the application.

ListCreditcardApplicationsDocumentsRespo.title: Get Applications Documents Response

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the document retrieval.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional context about the operation.

audit.description: Details regarding the audit of the operation.

ListCreditcardApplicationsDocumentsRespo.description: Response schema for retrieving application documents. Contains the status, reference number, result ID, state, processing time, message, and audit details.
